claims: Dan Serafini is a former MLB pitcher.
Dan Serafini is serving life in prison for the 2021 murder of his father-in-law and attempted murder of his mother-in-law in Lake Tahoe.
Dan Serafini speaks to Dateline's Keith Morrison in a jailhouse interview.
The Dateline episode is titled "Deadly Swagger".
The Dateline episode airs on NBC on April 17, 2026.
Dan Serafini maintains his innocence despite being convicted and sentenced to life without parole.
According to KCRA 3, Keith Morrison described Dan Serafini as "angry".
According to KCRA 3, Keith Morrison described Dan Serafini as upset about his conviction.
According to KCRA 3, Keith Morrison described Dan Serafini as having criticized the jury and justice system.
Prosecutors alleged Dan Serafini hired an accomplice to shoot his in-laws Robert Gary Spohr and Wendy Wood to access a $23 million inheritance.
Dan Serafini was convicted in July 2025.
Dan Serafini was sentenced to life in prison without the possibility of parole in February 2026.
Samantha Scott is a family friend.
Samantha Scott pleaded guilty to accessory after the fact.
Samantha Scott admitted to driving the getaway car.
Samantha Scott testified against Dan Serafini
